methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This implementation requires the estimation of a mathematical model that expresses the flow rate from the control signal of the solenoid valve and the gas pressure and temperature measurements. Two types of models are studied: LPV (Linear Parameter Varying) model with pressure and temperature as scheduling variables and a non-parametric model based on Gaussian processes.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The study focuses on installation of gas boiler with a power of 750kW, located on the Renardi`eres site of EDF R&D near Paris, France.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The objective of this project is to develop and test low-cost non-intrusive sensors to monitor and analyze the energy consumption of major flows used in the manufacturing sector (electricity, gas, compressed air).
